maplibre-gl 6.3.0 — vendored runtime distribution
=================================================
Source : https://registry.npmjs.org/maplibre-gl/-/maplibre-gl-6.3.0.tgz
SHA-256: c6ff93a1e8a5dc07464c26969c24b5653af7d42a9fbddb129f2521692e5c3bef
License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE.txt)

Files (the COMPLETE runtime set, verified by a dependency sweep of the dist):
  maplibre-gl.mjs         main ESM module   — imports ./maplibre-gl-shared.mjs
  maplibre-gl-shared.mjs  shared chunk      — imported by both main and worker
  maplibre-gl-worker.mjs  worker module     — imports ./maplibre-gl-shared.mjs
  maplibre-gl.css         stylesheet

Not vendored: *-dev.mjs (debug builds), maplibre-gl.d.ts (types), *.map.

Worker resolution (from the shipped source of 6.3.0):
  new URL('./maplibre-gl-worker.mjs', import.meta.url) launched with
  {type: 'module'} — a same-origin file, NOT a Blob URL. The Blob wrapper
  paths exist only for cross-origin worker URLs, which cannot occur here.
  setWorkerUrl(url) is the explicit override; the app sets it anyway so the
  worker location is stated, not inferred.

MIME: nginx must serve .mjs as application/javascript (or text/javascript);
      module loading fails silently on the default text/plain fallback.
